excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a museum preparator, curly black hair, African ethnicity, goatee. Wears a green tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, blue jeans and brown boots.
excavation_context.stage: Scribing Fine Matrix from a Delicate Skull Block

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_5 is working diligently at a laboratory workbench, using a fine pneumatic air-scribe tool to slice through smooth, dense greenish-grey siltstone matrix. His steady movements carefully isolate the small, fragile skull and large eye orbits of a Dryosaurus fossil. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
